r.r_api_key_env_note: Never hardcode the API key; read it from the environment.
r.r_cleanup_instances_note: Delete machines you created when the run ends
r.r_snapshot_immutable_note: A snapshot is immutable: boot a machine from it, never edit it.
r.r_sync_before_snapshot_note: Flush pending writes before taking a snapshot
r.r_ttl_positive_note: Every machine carries a positive time to live

Client.note: the entry point for every call

Machine.note: a running instance created from a snapshot

Snapshot.note: an immutable image a machine boots from

x.leaking a machine per test run: delete it in a fixture teardown
x.reusing a snapshot as writable storage: boot a machine and write there
